targets.query: from(bucket: "freezer_data") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_scores" and r._field == "ml_health_score") |> last() |> keep(columns: ["_value", "unit_id"])

from(bucket: "freezer_data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "readings" and r._field == "temperature") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "unit_id"])

from(bucket: "freezer_data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_scores" and r._field == "ml_health_score") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "unit_id"])

from(bucket: "freezer_data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_scores" and r._field == "anomaly") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "unit_id"])

from(bucket: "freezer_data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_scores" and r._field == "thermal_velocity") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "unit_id"])
